About us

Named for the Colorado columbine — and the landscapes it belongs to

Blue Columbine Landscaping is a Denver-based crew that treats your property like our own. We design and care for yards that suit the Front Range: water-wise, climate-hardy, and built to look good through every Colorado season.

We quote honestly, show up when we say we will, and finish clean. No runaround, no surprise fees — just dependable work from people who take pride in it.

  • Colorado-hardy, water-wise plant choices
  • Clear, no-obligation estimates
  • Tidy crews who clean up after every visit
  • Serving Denver and the surrounding metro

FAQ

Good to know

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. Tell us about your project and we'll give you a clear, no-obligation quote — usually within a day.

What areas do you serve?

Denver and the greater Denver metro, plus surrounding Front Range communities. Not sure if you're in range? Just ask.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — we're fully insured, so your property is covered and you can relax while we work.

Do you design water-wise and xeriscape yards?

Absolutely. We specialize in Colorado-hardy, low-water landscapes — native beds, rock, drip irrigation, and xeriscape designs that look great and save water.

How soon can you come out?

Often within a few days. Send us a message or call and we'll find the soonest slot that works for you.
